Page counter: "Total Shipments 31 Records detected", "Trading Partners 1", "Ports 2"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (3 export, 2 import). Buyer table shows 7 shipments to NUZHAAT HOLDINGS (Zambia), 5 to ABAQ AL LUBAN (Oman), 2+1 to A.M SWEDISH FZ-LLC (UAE), 1 to CONTINENT (Bashkortostan, Russia) — i.e. export lanes to Zambia, Oman, UAE, Russia.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and destinations (Oman 39204900, Zambia 48232000, UAE 84224000), not merely website claims. Declared HS 240311 (tobacco products) and 842240 (packing machinery) do not match the observed export HS codes (39204900 plastic/laminate, 48232000 filter paper) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; actual HS should be corrected to 39204900/48232000 for the export lines, while 84224000 appears only on machinery imports (vertical form-fill-seal machines bought from Shanghai Chengqi / A.M Swedish FZ-LLC), i.e. the company is a buyer of 842240 equipment, not an exporter of it. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search backend was down (searx connection refused) and registry pages (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown with null evidence rather than inferred. Revenue/export volume figures are not public in the free view — null, not estimated. Role appears to be manufacturer_trader (buys packing machines and filter paper, sells laminated tea-bag covers/filter paper abroad).
